title: The Citizen
description:
The Citizen

The Citizen is a first person narrative comedy game (absurdist narrator-fetish) about “how to deal with important subjects without saying anything”. Featuring completed sentences, the game transcends the bare minimum steam requirements.

FEATURING MULTIPLE TASTE:

Play it your way! Depending on your taste, you might dislike this game while others might enjoy it. We have worked hard to maintain this freedom while keeping all of the content exactly the same regardless.

• 🗣️The game transcends the human realm utilizing a completely unnecessary sound production.

• ⏰15 mins of playtime!

• 🚪Many cool doors to pass through.

• 👶Several babies.

Hi, it's SkyBrave! I make short games every month! Join my Discord channel to stay connected!
